listing.name: Gears of War 3 — Gears3-Azura (Carolux97)
listing.summary: Upstream reports campaign and local two-player co-op support. Online co-op is unavailable. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own complete extracted Gears of War 3 Xbox 360 files, including the original executable. Match the media ID and hash in versions.toml; do not assume another region is compatible.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: On macOS or Linux, use the separate Azura launcher to generate and compile from your own ISO or extracted folder. Keep updates under the launcher’s control.

warnings: Upstream reports campaign and local two-player co-op support. Online co-op is unavailable.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
